title: Sectorial Finitely Generated Dynamical Frames
summary: We study frames of unilateral iterations generated by finitely many vectors under an invertible bounded operator $T$. Suppose that the spectrum of $T$ lies in $\{ρe^{it}:0 c_{\mathrm e}/π$ and its logarithmic block density satisfies $L(Λ)>c/π$. Completeness at the latter threshold requires only an invertible operator with spectrum in the corresponding angular sector and a complete integer multiorbit.
